text.text:
We’ve created MIS attachments in two lengths—13 cm and 16 cm—and three styles: straight, angled and curved.
 
  • Refined design for improved balance and maneuverability
  • Alignment dots and Snap-Connect for accurate, easy assembly and disassembly
  • Color coding that instantly identifies matching attachments and cutting accessories
  • Longer, concave design for improved sightlines
  • Fine-edge knurling for enhanced grip and positioning options

largeheadline.line1: Our universal MIS hub creates a safe, secure connection between any attachment and any compatible drill.
